content:
Nina (mktg): planning thread for the May newsletter + webinar promo. goal: drive demo signups and benchmark downloads. need segmentation + send plan.
Carlos (growth): primary segments: 1) trials (last 30d), 2) active freemium (api_calls>100/mo), 3) signups from benchmarks page. each gets a tailored subject/body.
Riya (deliverability): heads up: avoid image-heavy designs for trials group, smaller sends first 2 hours to protect IP. warmup required for new subdomain if used.
Tom (events): webinar details: "Scaling inference: cost vs latency" May 18 11am PT. Promo window: 2 emails (invite + reminder) + one newsletter blurb. offer recording.
Jared (analytics): metric set: reg signups, demo requests, webinar RSVPs, benchmark downloads, 7/14 day api delta. will supply baseline conversion rates.
Nina (mktg): cadence idea: Day 0 send = segmented invite, Day 3 follow = case study highlight, Day 10 final = FOMO + recording if missed. plus newsletter on Monday with benchmark summary.
Carlos (growth): subject line tests per segment: Trials: "3 quick wins to reduce inference cost", Freemium: "How top teams cut token spend 30%", Benchmarks: "New Redwood benchmarks: p50/p95 breakdown". A/B for personalization on org size.
Riya (deliverability): prefer using minimal personalization tokens. test `{{company_size}}` only. also include List-Unsubscribe header, and suppress `hard_bounce` historicals.
Tom (events): webinar landing page: https://redwood.com/events/scale-inference - include utm_source=newsletter utm_campaign=webinar_may. please confirm tokens.
Jared (analytics): confirmed UTMs. SQL cohort for trials: SELECT id FROM users WHERE created_at >= now()-interval '30 days' AND api_calls < 10; (we'll parameterize).
Nina (mktg): creative ask to Content: two short blocks: 1) benchmark highlight + CTA, 2) webinar invite + CTA. need 3 subject variants and preheader.
Riya (deliverability): schedule plan: seed 50 internal test addresses + 1% to live for QA. monitor bounce & spam complaints for +24h before ramp.
Carlos (growth): routing: send trials via apisender domain, others via main. Riya, need your sign-off on subdomain plan by Wed EOD.
Riya (deliverability): will review Wed before 3pm. if we need warmup, might push non-critical sends a week.
Jared (analytics): tracking: create dashboard widget for cohort-level funnel and a slack alert if reg signups < 75% of baseline. I'll set it up.
Nina (mktg): SDR ops: add a play for webinar RSVPs with high interest (clicked demo link) -> outreach within 24h. Carlos you ok to draft?
Carlos (growth): yep will draft the SDR brief and example lines. linking to google doc when done.
Tom (events): timeline: content due Tue noon, HTML/ESP build Wed, QA Thu, seed Fri morning, full rollout Mon.
Nina (mktg): owners: content = Lena (cc'd), ESP build = Marcus, analytics = Jared, deliverability = Riya, events page = Tom.
kai-bot: reminder set: #marketing Monday 09:00 "Newsletter + webinar send day"
Lena (content): I'll post subject/body drafts to the content board by Tue 11am and include plain-text fallback.
Marcus (not-present): noted on build, will reserve send window 10am-2pm PT.
Riya (deliverability): one tiny ask: avoid capitalized subject tokens like FREE or DISCOUNT. they spike spam filters.
Nina (mktg): good catch. we'll avoid that. one last confirm: suppression lists — include unsubscribes, hard bounces, and `engagement_unsubscribe`. Jordan (ops) to confirm export?
Jared (analytics): export done via schedule; will share link to segment before Wed.
Carlos (growth): can we include a short micro survey in the Day 10 email: "Which topic would you like next?" one-click options. good for content planning.
Tom (events): yes include, put it before CTA so we capture clicks.
Nina (mktg): OK team. let's reconvene Thu 3pm for final QA signoff. thanks. :tada:
kai-bot: calendar event created: "Newsletter & Webinar QA" Thu 15:00 - #marketing
